info.title: API.SH: Rightmove
info.description: The Rightmove API from API.SH: public Rightmove data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
One estate agent branch on rightmove.co.uk: name, brand, company, address, coordinates, sales and lettings phone numbers, description, logo, industry affiliations, a preview of its stock for sale and to let, recently sold and let homes, its sister branches, and one page of its current listings (24 per page, the same fields as /rightmove/v1/listings). Branch links appear as `agent.url` in /rightmove/v1/listings and /rightmove/v1/property. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; it is null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rightmove-agent

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Branch page link (https://www.rightmove.co.uk/estate-agents/agent/<brand>/<branch>-<id>.html). Either url or branch_id is required.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.description: Numeric branch id (the number at the end of the branch link, or `agent.branch_id` in listing results).

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Which listings to page through: buy (for sale) or rent (to let). Default: buy, or rent for a lettings-only branch.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Listing order: newest (default), oldest, price_desc, price_asc.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Listings page (24 per page, up to 42). Pass `next_page` from the previous response.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Each page is the next 24 listings. `next_page` is null on the last page.

Optional filters as on the site: price range, bedrooms, property types, search radius, sort and how recently the listing was added. `filters` echoes the filters applied.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rightmove-listings

parameters.name: location_id
parameters.description: Identifier from location lookup, including the type prefix.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number. Pass `next_page` from the previous response; `next_page` is null on the last page.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Minimum price in GBP (per month for rentals).

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Maximum price in GBP (per month for rentals).

parameters.name: min_bedrooms
parameters.description: Minimum bedrooms (0-10).

parameters.name: max_bedrooms
parameters.description: Maximum bedrooms (0-10).

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: detached, semi-detached, terraced, flat, bungalow, land, park-home.

parameters.name: radius
parameters.description: Search radius in miles around the location: 0 (default), 0.25, 0.5, 1, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30 or 40.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: price_desc (default), price_asc, newest or oldest.

parameters.name: max_days_since_added
parameters.description: Only listings added in the last 1, 3, 7 or 14 days.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 2 credits per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rightmove-similar

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Rightmove property link (rightmove.co.uk/properties/123456789) or the bare property id.

get.description:
Sold prices from HM Land Registry on Rightmove: each home with its address, type, bedrooms, coordinates and every past sale (price, date, tenure, new build), 25 per page up to 40 pages, plus the area summary. Plain request to the page's data route (~50 KB). Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/rightmove-sold

parameters.name: location
parameters.description: Place name as in Rightmove house-price URLs (london, manchester, sw1a…).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A Rightmove /house-prices/… URL instead of location.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page (1-40); pass `next_page` back.

parameters.name: property_type
parameters.description: detached, semi_detached, terraced, flat, other.

parameters.name: sold_in
parameters.description: Sold within the last N years: 1, 2, 3, 5, 10, 15, 20.

parameters.name: tenure
parameters.description: freehold or leasehold.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: newest, oldest, price_desc, price_asc, address.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
